sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Endurance is a Physical skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Endurance influences the amount of stamina and the rate of exhaustion while running or jumping, as well as holding and recovering breath.

sections.heading: Hideout
sections.text:
- Level 1 of this skill is needed for the Heating level 2
- Level 2 of this skill is needed for the Security level 2

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Increases stamina (1% per level → +50% at Elite Level)
- Reduces jump stamina drain (0.6% per level → -30% at Elite Level)
- Increases breath holding (2% per level → +100% at Elite Level)
- Reduces breath recovery time (1% per level → -50% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: Increases stamina (+20% → +70% total)
- Elite level: Increased arm endurance
- Elite level: Breathing is independent of energy

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- Sprinting while not being overweight (i.e yellow or red number)
- Walking while not being overweight (i.e yellow or red number)
- Completing quick time events (QTE) in the Gym
- Completing the quest A Life Lesson
- Completing the quest Never Too Late To Learn

sections.heading: Tips
sections.text: - Using a stimulant to temporarily increase carrying capacity or strength at the start of a raid will generally put the player below overweight, allowing endurance to be leveled.
